title: [29.X][Repair Item][SaaS][Drop shipment reversal] Undo Shipment fails with blank Bin Code at bin-mandatory location
summary: Fixed an issue where undoing a shipment would fail when a bin code was blank at locations requiring bins during drop shipment reversals.
key_points: Corrects undo operations for sales shipments and purchase receipts when bin codes are missing
Addresses drop shipment reversal scenarios at bin-mandatory warehouse locations
Adds test coverage for the item tracking and reservation functionality
